decision.explanation: The question asks which educational institution Mala Majumdar attended. Two distinct claims are present in the provided sources. Document d1 explicitly states that Mala Majumdar attended Monash University for her Bachelor of Arts in Sociology (D1S5). Document d2 asserts that she attended Jain University (D2S3). Both claims are direct and refer to the same individual and relation (attended), but they name different institutions. Since the sources do not resolve the contradiction and both are presented as valid, both answers are retained as separate valid referents.
